title: perf(canary): auto-detect regressions and add rollout guards for canary promotions
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Canaries are our primary defense against performance regressions in production inference. Manual thresholds and ad-hoc checks produce both false positives and missed regressions. This PR implements an automated detection pipeline and rollout guard integration to make canary promotions safe and deterministic. Goals: 1) automatically surface latency/throughput regressions against baseline canaries, 2) provide a configurable, model/route-aware scoring mechanism, 3) block unsafe promotions via rollout guards and automated rollback hooks, 4) integrate with dashboards and alerts for SRE/owners. Design summary: added a canary-analysis service that consumes per-route time-series from the perf-canary ingestion pipeline, computes a lightweight regression_score using a sliding-window robust estimator (median + MAD) and a secondary throughput-signal check, and emits a canary_regression_score and contributing factors. Scores are normalized per model/route using historical baselines and seasonality windows. A policy engine evaluates score + statistically-significant tests (bootstrap/KS-lite) against configurable thresholds and produces one of: pass, warn, fail. Fail results produce a rollout_guard block that prevents canary promotion; warn results create a review task but do not auto-block. Implementation details: - services/perf-canary: new analysis worker, scoring library, policy evaluation module. - api/rollouts: added rollout_guard endpoints and new state machine hooks (canary_evaluation -> blocked/promote/rollback). - observability: new Grafana dashboard panels, a canary_regression_score metric, and alerting rules (SLO-aware). - infra: Helm chart changes to enable analysis workers and feature-flag toggles. - tests: expanded canary-harness with synthetic regression scenarios and end-to-end integration job. Migration/rollout plan: feature-gated behind perf_canary_v2 flag (default off). Stage 1: enable analysis in staging and run in audit-only mode for 2 weeks. Stage 2: enable rollout_guard in non-prod canaries and tune thresholds via feedback. Stage 3: opt-in by region for production canaries (SRE-led). Stage 4: global enable by default with opt-out by route. Compatibility and safety: analysis uses conservative defaults to minimize false positives; thresholds are tunable per-model and we keep a historical audit trail for manual review. The PR includes simulation results (see tests/perf/simulations/summary) demonstrating 92% true-positive detection on injected 10-20% p99 latency regressions and <3% false positive rate on noisy baselines. Tests/CI: added unit tests for scoring math, integration tests for the rollout guard state transitions, and a smoke test for the full canary flow. CI initially had a flaky integration test (timing-sensitive), which was fixed by adding deterministic clocks to the harness; final CI status is pass. Checklist: ensure feature-flag rollout, notify platform on-call, stage threshold tuning session, update runbooks. Related: ENG-3147 for scoring infra, SRE-826 for alerting rules. Release notes: Adds automated performance-canary detection and rollout guard integration to prevent promotion of canaries with statistically significant latency/throughput regressions. Default gated behind perf_canary_v2. See docs/perf-canary.md for usage and configuration.

review_comments: Diego Martinez (2026-02-26): Suggest tightening the p99 threshold to be relative to baseline MAD instead of fixed percentiles; avoids noisy routes spamming alerts.
Asha Patel (2026-02-26): Updated scoring to use MAD-normalized thresholds and added per-route override map. See scoring.py commit.
Maya Singh (2026-02-27): Can we make the rollout_guard evaluation asynchronous to avoid blocking the rollout controller? Concerned about tail latency amplification.

Asha Patel (2026-02-27): The policy engine returns a short-circuit decision; evaluation runs in the analysis worker and posts the result to rollout_guard endpoint — controller polls with backoff. Added mention in api/rollouts/README.

release_notes: Adds automated canary analysis and rollout guards to detect and block latency/throughput regressions. Feature-gated (perf_canary_v2) and off by default. Includes dashboards, alerts, and runbook updates.
notes_for_ops: Feature is behind perf_canary_v2 flag. Staging enablement recommended for 2 weeks in audit-only mode. SRE to run threshold tuning session and verify alerting. Rollback hooks will automatically revert canaries flagged as fail.
